steps.caller_intent: Refer to a fabricated virtual court notice that the listener has not received through any official channel.
steps.example_line: A virtual hearing notice has been issued against your name for an online loan fraud case.

steps.caller_intent: Make a fake video hearing seem more credible by offering a case number and a supposed clerk transfer.
steps.example_line: I will connect the court clerk now; keep this case number ready for the video hearing.

steps.caller_intent: Turn the supposed hearing into a private confinement demand.
steps.example_line: Stay alone on camera until the magistrate releases you; leaving the call will count as non-compliance.

steps.caller_intent: Make the first dangerous request for remote access under the guise of identity verification.
steps.example_line: Install this screen-sharing app and let the clerk control your phone to verify your identity before the hearing.

steps.caller_intent: Reinforce the fake procedure if the listener asks to check the notice independently.
steps.example_line: Checking the court site can wait until this confidential hearing is finished.

steps.caller_intent: Return a caller's inquiry about an unexpected virtual hearing message.
steps.example_line: You asked our court information desk how to check a video hearing notice sent to your phone.

steps.caller_intent: Explain how to check the claimed case independently without accepting the message as authentic.
steps.example_line: Please look up the case number through the court's published website or contact details.

steps.caller_intent: Distinguish an official inquiry from a demand to remain on a private call.
steps.example_line: You can end this call while you verify the notice; there is no need to stay on camera with me.

steps.caller_intent: Offer the next ordinary route if the case number cannot be found.
steps.example_line: If the case number does not appear there, use the court's published contact details to ask the registry.

steps.caller_intent: Claim that an ordinary parcel could not be delivered because the address is incomplete.
steps.example_line: Your package is at the local sorting hub because the flat number is missing.

steps.caller_intent: Offer a plausible tracking detail while withholding independent verification.
steps.example_line: The tracking record ends in 4821; I can correct the address before the van leaves.

steps.caller_intent: Make the first dangerous request through a look-alike redelivery link that collects card details.
steps.example_line: Open the address-fix link I just texted and enter your card details for the small redelivery charge.

steps.caller_intent: Pressure the listener against checking the original merchant order.
steps.example_line: The order app will not show this hub correction in time, so use my link now.

steps.caller_intent: Respond to a customer's earlier request to reroute an undelivered parcel.
steps.example_line: I am following up on the pickup-point change you requested for your parcel.

steps.caller_intent: Have the customer confirm the new location using their existing order channel.
steps.example_line: The available pickup point and tracking status are in the merchant app you already use.

steps.caller_intent: Set an ordinary pickup expectation without asking for a code over the phone.
steps.example_line: Please wait for the app's ready-for-pickup notice before going to the counter.

steps.caller_intent: Explain the routine identification check at the pickup counter.
steps.example_line: When the pickup notice arrives, bring the order's pickup code and your ID to the counter.

steps.caller_intent: Pretend to follow up on a recent address change in a digital wallet, rather than a routine bank KYC deadline.
steps.example_line: Your wallet address-change request is pending a video KYC review.

steps.caller_intent: Use the claimed request history to make an outside verification channel sound normal.
steps.example_line: The old address is still on file, so a separate review desk must match your identity documents.

steps.caller_intent: Introduce a consequence for declining the outside channel.
steps.example_line: The address change cannot be completed until this review is done today.

steps.caller_intent: Make the first dangerous request for identity documents through a caller-supplied upload link.
steps.example_line: Open my verification link and upload both sides of your ID card and a live selfie there.

steps.caller_intent: Acknowledge a customer-initiated address update in a wallet account.
steps.example_line: You contacted us about changing the address shown in your wallet profile.

steps.caller_intent: Explain that any required identity review appears inside the customer's own app.
steps.example_line: If verification is needed, the request status and steps will appear when you open the official app yourself.

steps.caller_intent: Allow the customer to stop the call and use published support independently.
steps.example_line: You can end this call and contact support from inside the app if the request is missing.

steps.caller_intent: Reject off-channel identity collection.
steps.example_line: Do not send me ID photos, a selfie, or a code through a link I give you.

steps.caller_intent: Exploit a lost-card situation by claiming to handle a cardholder's own block request.
steps.example_line: Your card-block request after losing the card at the station has reached our desk.

steps.caller_intent: Suggest that the block has a dangerous gap rather than being complete.
steps.example_line: The physical card is blocked, but its saved online payments remain active until we finish the second check.

steps.caller_intent: Make the first dangerous request to authorize a UPI collect payment disguised as card-security verification.
steps.example_line: Approve the 1,999-rupee UPI collect payment I just sent; it is the card-security verification needed to shut off online payments.

steps.caller_intent: Add loss pressure to discourage calling published support.
steps.example_line: If you call the number on the card later, an online purchase may go through first.

steps.caller_intent: Follow up on a cardholder's own lost-card block request.
steps.example_line: I am returning your request about the card you reported missing at the station.

steps.caller_intent: Direct the cardholder to independently confirm the existing block status.
steps.example_line: Please check the card status in your bank app or call the published support number.

steps.caller_intent: Explain the ordinary next step without inviting reactivation on this call.
steps.example_line: You can request a replacement card through those same bank channels.

steps.caller_intent: Give the next ordinary step after a confirmed block.
steps.example_line: The replacement-card request and its delivery status will appear in the same app.

steps.caller_intent: Claim regulator involvement in a duplicate eSIM request made without the listener's consent.
steps.example_line: A second eSIM has been requested for your number, and the telecom regulator has flagged it.

steps.caller_intent: Frame loss of the current SIM as the near-term consequence.
steps.example_line: Your present SIM will stop working when that new eSIM activates later today.

steps.caller_intent: Pretend a code is needed to cancel the duplicate request.
steps.example_line: I can reverse the activation from this desk before the disconnection happens.

steps.caller_intent: Make the first dangerous request for the carrier activation code.
steps.example_line: Read me the eSIM activation code the carrier just sent you so I can cancel the duplicate.

steps.caller_intent: Block independent checking after the code demand.
steps.example_line: Do not visit the carrier store until this cancellation is complete.

steps.caller_intent: Return a customer's inquiry about a SIM replacement request they made themselves.
steps.example_line: You asked when your old SIM will stop working after your replacement request.

steps.caller_intent: Explain the service transition without claiming an unverified regulator order.
steps.example_line: The old SIM's status is visible in your carrier account as the replacement is processed.

steps.caller_intent: Provide a carrier-controlled verification route for an unexpected duplicate request.
steps.example_line: If you did not request a replacement, contact the carrier through its app or store immediately.

steps.caller_intent: Avoid requesting activation secrets on the call.
steps.example_line: Do not read an activation code to me or to anyone who calls you.

steps.caller_intent: Claim that a disputed meter reading created a billing-account mismatch, rather than an unpaid bill.
steps.example_line: The meter photo on your reading dispute does not match the number linked to your electricity account.

steps.caller_intent: Use a supposed inspection workflow to create credibility.
steps.example_line: An inspector has opened a correction ticket, but the account must be verified before the visit.

steps.caller_intent: Threaten suspension as a consequence of failing the fake verification.
steps.example_line: If the meter is not matched today, service to this account will be suspended automatically.

steps.caller_intent: Make the first dangerous request for device access rather than a bill payment.
steps.example_line: Install our inspection app and enable screen sharing so I can fix the meter record on your phone.

steps.caller_intent: Dismiss the utility's normal dispute channel.
steps.example_line: The public portal cannot clear this internal ticket, so keep the screen-sharing session open.

steps.caller_intent: Follow up on a customer's submitted meter-reading dispute.
steps.example_line: I am calling about the meter-reading complaint you filed for your electricity account.

steps.caller_intent: Describe a normal review path rather than demanding immediate settlement.
steps.example_line: The reading will be reviewed against the meter record, and an inspection may be scheduled.

steps.caller_intent: Give an independently verifiable status source.
steps.example_line: You can track the complaint in the utility's official account portal or through published support.

steps.caller_intent: Set an ordinary follow-up expectation for the complaint.
steps.example_line: Keep the complaint reference number; the account portal will show the result after the reading is checked.
